correctness.rationale: The fixed ternary family A_n={3^i-1}, i=0..n-1, is distinguished at total multiplicity 2n by k_i=2. Since total counts match, the offset -1 cancels, leaving even difference V=sum k_i3^i-(3^n-1). The minimal coin count gamma_n(M)=floor(M/3^(n-1))+s_3(M mod 3^(n-1)); all other feasible counts arise by splitting a 3^j coin into three 3^(j-1) coins, preserving parity. For N*=(3^n-3^t)/2 with n-t odd and 3^t<=2n-1, N* odd: negative multiples violate M>=2n; positive multiples h(3^n-3^t) have gamma=2n+3h-s_3(h)>2n. All smaller even N and small odd N admit a negative difference; remaining odd N yield dprime=3^n-2N with s_3(dprime)>=3 (opposite exponent parity excludes one-digit powers), producing a positive rival. Independently exhausted all weak compositions and candidate moduli for n=2..6: minima 3,13,39,117,363. The proof, not finite n, covers n>=2.
